shape_reconciliation: The current six contains 3 existing canonicals and 3 candidates. To keep the requested batch sizes without duplicating or omitting any of the 20 target IDs, Batch 3 is mixed.

mass_production_gate.after_gate: Proceed through batches without reopening architecture for each character; stop only for a real identity, art, or compatibility blocker.
mass_production_gate.candidate_guard: Gate 1 canonical decisions remain required for candidate IDs; the mass gate does not register candidates or grant runtime authority.

locked_contract.default_pose: One full-body, empty/open-hand default pose per intended character.
locked_contract.sword_multiplication_rule: One pose per CHARACTER x WEAPON_FAMILY; wooden_sword, iron_sword, and fox_fang reuse the family and do not create per-item art.
